newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open lower as weaker Wall Street weighs.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open lower as weaker Wall Street weighs.

text.p: British shares were hit by an early mark-down on Wednesday in the wake of a weaker Wall Street but quickly bounced back into positive ground, helped by firmer bonds and a strong performance by British Telecom shares.
The FTSE 100 index opened 8.1 points lower at 4,348.7 but began heading higher straight away and was up 2.3 points at 4,359.1 by 0845 GMT.

"We managed to brush off the effects of Wall Street fairly quickly and we'll be looking to data for direction for the rest of the day," one dealer said. "Things could be volatile until the figures are out of the way."
